title: MigrationState
$comment: Dual-build state manager: the resumable, per-unit-reversible record. The agent updates it after every unit; tools/state.py validates it.

judge_validation.$comment: Stage 2 hard gate: judge-first results before any translation

status.$comment: ported/escalated etc. always keep python fallback until 'retired' in Stage 7

notes.$comment: per-unit audit trail; prose for humans (tools/glv-subagents.md)

sessions.$comment: per-unit session audit trail when delegates run as GLV sessions; the orchestrator, never a delegate, writes these

gate.$comment: scope_change = MIGRATION_PROMPT.md mandatory gate 'any scope change later'; no_equivalent_dependency is resolved by policy DEP-1 (descope, never a substitution)

state.$comment: deferred = resolved by policy as defer-not-halt (ESC-1); a resolved gate is never blocking

decided_by.$comment: 'human' or 'policy:<rule-id>' referencing autonomy/policy.json (state.py checks the pattern and the rule id); required on any non-open gate

policy_version.$comment: the autonomy/policy.json version the rule was evaluated against (required when decided_by starts with policy:)

evidence.$comment: key=value measurement records the policy evaluated (or the human reviewed): spike_verdict=, bench_improvement_pct=, shadow_diff_rate=, shadow_samples=, canary_green_minutes=, rollback_tested=, module=, python= — extracted, never invented

autonomy.$comment: Pre-authorized autonomy for this run (issue #22). Set once BEFORE the run starts (state.py init --autonomy-level / pipeline.py run --autonomy) and journaled on change; the driver enforces it, the agent cannot raise it mid-run. There are zero mid-run questions at L2+.

level.$comment: L0 supervised (hard stops: the gate stays open, the run ends with the dossier — the operator decides between runs, nothing asks mid-run) · L1 agent proposes into the dossier, operator decides between runs · L2 all gates policy-resolved (the default), publish disabled · L3 full autopilot incl. cutover

policy_version.$comment: autonomy/policy.json version in force for this run

budget.$comment: run-level ceilings enforced by tools/pipeline.py; over either ceiling the run ends in the budget_exhausted terminal state

publish_allowed.$comment: must be true (L3 only) for a policy-approved cutover; state.py rejects the combination otherwise

run_status.$comment: Terminal-state discipline (issue #22): a driver run ALWAYS ends in complete / no_go_measured / budget_exhausted / failed_safely — never 'awaiting input'. Every terminal state emits the same deliverable set (run report incl. the escalation dossier, state file, journal).

journal.$comment: append-only transition log; every state.py write appends one entry — 'every state transition journaled' (tools/README.md #4)

unit.$comment: unit id, or null for project-level fields (e.g. stage)

field.$comment: dotted path to the changed field, e.g. stage or units[u3].status

from.$comment: any JSON value; null = previously unset

to.$comment: any JSON value; null = now unset

actor.$comment: who made the transition: orchestrator, state.py, or a GLV session id

budget_ledger.$comment: running totals vs the Stage 0 projection; deviations reported in the end-of-run report (and reviewed by the operator between runs)
